articles.summary: On March, Firefly’s Blue Ghost lunar lander softly touched down in Mare Crisium carrying 10 NASA instruments.
articles.title: Firefly Aerospace Becomes First Commercial Company to Successfully Land on the Moon

articles.summary: Following a successful rocket static fire test, Firefly's Alpha FLTA006 mission is scheduled to launch no earlier than March 15.
articles.title: Firefly Aerospace Ready to Launch Alpha FLTA006 for Lockheed Martin’s LM 400 Spacecraft No Earlier Than March 15

articles.summary: All 10 NASA CLPS instruments successfully operated on the lunar surface and collected their science data during Blue Ghost Mission 1.
articles.title: Firefly Aerospace Successfully Completes 14 Days of Surface Operations on the Moon

articles.summary: INCUS to launch on Firefly’s Alpha rocket as early as 2026 from NASA’s Wallops Flight Facility.
articles.title: Firefly Aerospace Awarded NASA Contract to Launch INCUS Mission from Wallops

articles.summary: From liftoff to landing, Firefly is providing live updates on its first mission to the Moon carrying 10 NASA instruments.
articles.title: Blue Ghost Mission 1: Live Updates

articles.summary: As part of Firefly’s third mission to the Moon, Blue Origin’s Honeybee Robotics rover will help investigate the Gruithuisen Gamma Dome.
articles.title: Firefly Aerospace Selects Blue Origin’s Honeybee Robotics to Provide Rover for Lunar Mission to Gruithuisen Domes
